Its docstring says the position is that of the rightmost matching (token, value) pair, and it ends with raise ValueError('(token, value) pair not found') when no match exists. The caller at raw.py:164 catches ValueError. radon/tests/test_raw.py:46-49 (test_find) checks the ValueError case. Both memory refs (A and C) say only to prioritize the file that best answers the request and give no file-specific priority. The shared preference therefore applies to the two files not named in the refs, B (complexity.py) and D (visitors.py), and I was asked to give them at least 40 minutes if feasible. I did not follow that. raw.py is the only file that contains the behavior, and complexity.py:41 has an unrelated ValueError. B and D get 15 minutes together (5 and 10), and A gets 30 as primary. C gets 15. I did not open metrics.py, complexity.py or visitors.py beyond the grep results.
